claim.value: Reduction should stop when no single remaining component can be removed while preserving failure.
claim.scope: Component-removal stopping criterion, distinct from safety, feasibility and time cutoffs.

provenance.rationale: P016 explicitly supplies this stopping condition. The claim does not assert that it is reached.

signal_basis.value: A reduced configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness while specified further removals do not, with test conditions fixed and a common repetition rule. Exhaustive single-component removal checks establish whether the component-removal stopping condition has been reached.
signal_basis.scope: The selected failure under the replay test; unresolved outcomes do not establish that a removal fails to preserve failure.

provenance.rationale: The cited bundle supplies the removal signal, controlled comparison, unresolved-outcome treatment and exhaustive-check requirement.
The bounded stopping rule is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: When no single remaining component can be removed while preserving the tested failure, stopping is warranted for this local component-removal criterion. The claim asserts neither global minimality nor that the criterion has already been met. Failure to reproduce after only specified removals would not alone establish that all single-component checks are exhausted.
uncertainty: Whether this stopping condition is actually reached is unspecified, but that does not undermine the conditional stopping rule.
